title: Battle for Baldur's Gate Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Elturel
entities.description: A city whose long-lost towers are seen again in sunlight after ascending from Avernus.

entities.name: Avernus
entities.description: A hellish realm from which Elturel ascends.

entities.name: Oghma
entities.description: A deity of knowledge served by archivists.

entities.name: Doen
entities.description: A purveyor of exotic pets who sells a displacer kitten.

entities.name: Elminster
entities.description: A wizard who improves upon the good ideas of others.

entities.name: Warnis
entities.description: A woman whose latent magical potential became a torrent of power when cultists attacked.

entities.name: The Emperor
entities.description: A figure to whom illithids claim the minds of their victims belong.

entities.name: Astarion
entities.description: A decadent figure distracted by others' bleeding.

entities.name: Bhaal
entities.description: A god whose mortal children carry a devouring darkness within them.

entities.name: Cult of the Absolute
entities.description: A cult whose members embrace power at any cost.

entities.name: The Night Serpent
entities.description: A patron entity that savors a warlock's ambition and dark hunger.

entities.name: Shadowheart
entities.description: A dark justiciar devoted to Shar.

entities.name: Shar
entities.description: A goddess whose will Shadowheart serves, associated with night.

entities.name: Hekaton
entities.description: The storm giant king who claims sole right to decide where lightning strikes.

entities.name: Jaheira
entities.description: A Harper and friend of the forest who seeks to help the Harpers' movement grow.

entities.name: The Harpers
entities.description: A growing movement that needs light to blossom.

entities.name: Monster Manual
entities.description: A detailed book whose monsters seem to jump off the page.

entities.name: The Outlands
entities.description: A realm traversed by a wandering treant.

entities.name: Baba Lysaga
entities.description: A night witch whose warm hospitality is worse than the cold night.

entities.name: The Council of Four
entities.description: The ruling council of Baldur's Gate, to whom the price of ambition is paid.

entities.name: Baldur's Gate
entities.description: A city where ambition has a price, home to the Upper City and Undercity.

entities.name: Gorion
entities.description: A wise mentor who keeps Abdel safe in Candlekeep.

entities.name: Abdel
entities.description: A young man sheltered by Gorion in Candlekeep.

entities.name: Candlekeep
entities.description: A place where Abdel is kept safe by Gorion.

entities.name: Patriars
entities.description: The wealthy noble class of Baldur's Gate, for whom wealth is in the blood.

entities.name: Quenton
entities.description: A vain man trapped by a Mirror of Life Trapping.

entities.name: Mirror of Life Trapping
entities.description: A mirror that traps those who gaze into it.

entities.name: Krizz
entities.description: A gate guard of Baldur's Gate who misunderstands the word 'eponymous'.

entities.name: Upper City
entities.description: A wealthy district of Baldur's Gate with meticulously tended gardens.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: A place with pools of unknown depth where amorphous horrors lurk.

entities.name: Gale
entities.description: A man who saw an uncanny stranger in a reflecting pool.

entities.name: Robe of the Archmagi
entities.description: A robe offering the power to shape worlds with style.

entities.name: Basilisk Collar
entities.description: A collar associated with exotic pets kept by patriars.

events.summary: Elturel's long-lost towers are seen in sunlight again amid smoke and rubble after its ascent from Avernus.
events.quote: sunlight shining on the long-lost towers of Elturel was still a beautiful sight.

events.summary: When cultists attack, Warnis's latent potential awakens into a torrent of magical power.
events.quote: That night, as the cultists attacked, it became a torrent of power that was hers to command.

events.summary: The Night Serpent tastes a warlock's ambition as she makes a pact.
events.quote: The Night Serpent tasted the warlock's ambition and savored the dark hunger in her soul.

events.summary: Gorion tells Abdel he is safest in Candlekeep but cannot keep him from the world forever.
events.quote: "You are safest in Candlekeep, Abdel, but I cannot keep you from the world forever."

events.summary: Quenton is trapped as reality collapses around him while admiring himself in the mirror.
events.quote: Quenton barely had a second to admire his exquisite handsomeness before reality collapsed around him.

events.summary: Gale stares into a pool and sees an uncanny stranger who is not him.
events.quote: Gale stared into the pool and saw a stranger.

relations.quote: "Shar's will shall be done. As sure as night will fall."
"The Harpers' movement grows, but it needs sunlight to blossom. We can be that light."
"You are safest in Candlekeep, Abdel, but I cannot keep you from the world forever."

relations.note: Ambition's price is paid to the Council
relations.quote: Ambition has a price in Baldur's Gate, and it is paid to the Council.
ensuring that Upper City residents aren't bothered by the messier parts of nature.
